The '''Farris Wheel''' was a chain of [[Casino/Legends|casinos]] operating in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. One of them was situated on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], located in [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin's]] [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]].
